title: Reconcile the March operating bank account
learnerBrief: March close. Reconcile the HLI-US operating bank account (account 1010) for March 2026. The bank feed is in the ERP. Report the reconciled cash balance, any unreconciled items, and anything that needs follow-up before we sign the close.

groundTruth.explanation: A single $18,450 deposit appears twice in the bank feed (3/12 and 3/14: a returned-then-resubmitted ACH). GL cash received it once. Two open AR invoices coincidentally match the amount, so a naive match reports 'reconciled'.
